results.title: What is the style of singing of Kumar Gandharva?
results.snippet: Blending Classical and Folk: While deeply rooted in classical music, Kumar Gandharva's approach was also influenced by folk music and devotional bhajans. He often combined the traditional ragas of Hindustani classical music with folk melodies, creating a fusion that was uniquely his.

results.title: Who is Kumar Gandharva also known as?
results.snippet: Pandit Kumar Gandharva (pronunciation: [kumaːɾ ɡən̪d̪ʱəɾʋə], Kn: ಕುಮಾರ್ ಗಂಧರ್ವ; 8 April 1924 – 12 January 1992), originally known as Shivaputra Siddharamayya Komkalimath was an Indian classical singer, well known for his unique vocal style and for his refusal to be bound by the tradition of any gharana.

results.title: What is 'Nirguni Bhajans' by Kumar Gandharva?
results.snippet: These items are known as "nirguni bhajans;" a "bhajan" is a religious song, and the adjective "nirguni" denotes a song directed not at a specific deity (as, for example, songs on the themes of Rama, Krishna, Durga, and others of the Hindu pantheon) but at what is loosely known as the "formless" divinity.
